task: manager-team-edits — managers rename and pause/reactivate own-team teachers/students; admin email change signs out an active user or re-invites an invited one
reviewer: vc-code-reviewer (independent agent, fresh context) on 2026-11-24; model substitution noted: the requested Claude Sonnet reviewer was unavailable (pay-as-you-go credits exhausted), so the review ran on the session default model with the identical reviewer prompt
decision: on-hold — user chose not to commit yet; no source change made after the review
rationale: No blocking defect. The authorization matrix, the single-transaction rewrite, the invite lifecycle, refresh revocation and activity hygiene are correct as written and were confirmed independently by both the EVL agent (claims a-g) and the reviewer. Two real non-blocking frontend defects were found and confirmed in the source by the orchestrator: (1) the API branch of updateTeacher/updateStudent never applies assertManagerKeepsEmail, so a manager's email change is silently discarded in API mode while the UI reports success, contradicting the local branch and the report's claim; (2) savedAccountOnly throws after a successful invited-email change, discarding the returned invite, so InviteResultModal never opens although the invitation committed and the link exists. The user chose to stop before committing rather than fix them now.
nonBlockingFindings: N1 (real, confirmed) — frontend/app/lib/school/services/people.ts:166-176 and :280-295: the API branch of updateTeacher/updateStudent does not call assertManagerKeepsEmail (the local branch does at :183 / :295); with frontend/app/lib/school/api/school.ts:86-88 dropping email for non-admins, a manager's email change is silently discarded in API mode while the UI says the record was updated. Fix: apply the guard in the API branch against the current school user.

N2 (real, confirmed) — frontend/app/lib/school/api/school.ts:100-109 with :142-157 / :174-183: savedAccountOnly throws after a successful account PATCH, discarding saved.invite. When the profile PATCH fails after an invited-email change, the invitation has committed and the link was returned but InviteResultModal never opens and the message never mentions an invitation. Fix: carry invite on the rethrown error (or return { invite, warning }) and open the modal.
N3 — school.ts:106 fixed copy 'Name and email were saved, but the profile details were not' is false for a manager, who only ever sends a name. Plan-mandated copy; misleading.

N4 — backend/src/lib/user-edit-policy.ts:52-57, 77-82: passwordUnusable is in UserPatchBefore and never read by planUserPatchEffects; the route computes it separately at users.ts:463-466. Dead parameter implying the policy enforces the never-activated rule.

N5 — user-edit-policy.ts:96-97: expireInvites is true for status 'paused' even when the target is already paused, so a redundant UPDATE auth_tokens runs; pinned by backend/tests/user-edit-policy.test.ts:194-198.

N6 — frontend/app/components/manager/PeopleForms.tsx:92, 142: the note is a <small> inside <label>, so it joins the input's accessible name rather than describing it; aria-describedby is the correct shape. Announced, so acceptable.

N7 — users.ts:457-460 with managerOwnsInTx (:196-207): a manager can pause (not only rename) an enrollment-only student who is not on their roster. Intended per U6 but only the rename case is proven by smoke (teStudentB); the pause authority is untested.

N8 — backend/src/plugins/auth.ts:7-13: authenticate never checks account status, so a paused or archived MANAGER keeps team-write authority (rename, pause) for up to 15 minutes. Widen access-token-revocation_NOTE_24-11-26.md accordingly.
N9 — the report frontmatter status and section 7.1 were out of step with the pack while the EVL check was pending; corrected in the report after the EVL run.
N10 — harness/manager-team-edits/review-decision.json was absent when the EVL ran; written as this file.
residuals: 15-minute access JWT — ship as recorded. Pre-existing (plugins/auth.ts verifies the signature only); this change strictly improves the posture by revoking refresh tokens inside the transaction on pause and on an admin email change. Widen the note per N8.

Sub-second ownership reassignment race — ship as recorded. Consequence bounded to a rename or pause of a teacher/student, actor-logged and reversible; enrollment-derived ownership cannot be FOR SHARE-locked without a design change. Correctly not counted as PASS.

Manager can reactivate an admin-paused member — ship, but the weakest residual: it lets a manager reverse a deliberate admin control with only an activity row as trace. U2 is a locked user decision, so not this change's defect; the admin-pause marker follow-up should not slip past launch.

Admin invited-email cooldown 0 — ship as recorded. The mitigation is real (global limiter at backend/src/app.ts:120, 300/min/IP default) but coarse: a compromised admin gets roughly 300 mails/min to arbitrary addresses, so per-sender-invite-limit is the residual's actual bound and should land before launch, not after.
notes: EVL: all 10 gates PASS with margins and claims a-g CONFIRMED; its FAIL line referred only to this file being absent. No hard-stop event in either run. Tree left uncommitted at the user's request.
